Age & Date Toolkit

Privacy policy

Age & Date Toolkit is an Android app by JN86VI for date and age calculations and saved dates. This policy explains local data, Android backups, Google advertising and purchases, and the external services you choose to use.

Last updated 8 November 2026

JN86VI · jn86apps@outlook.com

Android app ID: hu.jn86.agedatetoolkit

Intended audience

The app is intended for adults aged 18 and over. It has no age-verification question or age gate. A birth date you enter to calculate an age is a calculation input, not a declaration of your own age, and is not passed to advertising or consent services. The intended audience is separate from the store’s content rating.

Calculations on your device

Age, date differences, adding or subtracting years, months, weeks and days, birthdays and anniversaries, date information and days until or since a date are calculated on your device. These functions, saved dates and the reverse-clock feature work offline, without a JN86 account or calculation server. The app does not send your dates, names or results to JN86, AdMob, UMP or Play Billing. It does not synchronize with your calendar or a JN86 cloud service.

Saved dates and settings

When you save a date, the app stores its name, calendar date and an internal record ID in its private storage so you can load, edit or delete it. The ID identifies the saved item, not you as an advertising user. Storage also includes format/version and integrity information. Language and theme are saved separately. Calculator inputs, results, selections and navigation are temporary session state; they are not an automatically saved calculation history and may disappear when the app process ends.

Retention and local deletion

Saved dates remain until you edit or delete them; there is no automatic expiry. You can delete individual entries after confirmation. Clearing or changing a calculator input does not delete saved dates. Settings remain until changed or cleared. Android’s Clear storage/app data or uninstall removes local app data. Copies in Android backups, the clipboard or other apps require separate management and may survive local deletion. Restoring a backup can bring saved records back.

Android backup and restore

Android can include saved dates and app settings, including language and theme, in system cloud backup or device-to-device transfer according to your device, account and backup settings. JN86 operates no backup server and offers no separate file export/import. Only the saved-date store and settings database are included; temporary calculations, caches, restore staging, advertising/consent SDK state and ad-removal entitlement are excluded. Restored dates are validated before replacing the local list; invalid or unsupported data is not accepted as a successful restore. The backup provider controls transport, availability and retention; manage copies in Android or account settings.

Copying results

The Copy action puts a result on the Android clipboard only when you request it. Android and any app into which you paste it control its further use and may store or send it under their own policies. Copying does not export all saved dates. The app has no dedicated date-file export/import or automatic sharing service.

Your advertising choices

After you choose the app language, Google User Messaging Platform (UMP) checks your privacy status when the app is in the foreground and has an internet connection. To decide whether to show a form, UMP can contact Google before you agree to ads. It can send your IP address, app and device details, screen information, language and stored consent signals. UMP stores your choices on the device. Google can also process your interactions with the form.

UMP determines which form and privacy choices apply in your region. When privacy options are available, use Settings → Privacy options to review or change your choices, withdraw consent or use applicable opt-outs. A form is not shown in every country. Your choices do not restrict date calculations or saved dates, and buying or restoring ad removal is independent of advertising consent.

AdMob banner ads

The free app can display Google AdMob banner ads. Requests require an internet connection, the app in the foreground, an eligible banner space, permission to request ads and no verified ad-free entitlement. Unresolved or blocked permission prevents ad requests. A missing banner is not replaced by a local promotion or an empty ad strip. Verified ad removal suppresses banners, including offline.

The ad mode follows the applicable regional rules and your choices. Personalized ads require the necessary consent; non-personalized or limited ads are requested only when their conditions are met. Limited ads still use technical data for delivery and fraud prevention, which can include fraud-prevention storage. Where supported, US opt-outs concerning sale, sharing or targeted advertising restrict Google’s processing. Declining personalization or using an opt-out does not by itself remove all ads. An absent form is not treated as consent to personalization.

Depending on the ad mode and your choices, Google and participating ad providers can process your IP address (including approximate location derived from it), app/ad interactions, performance and crash diagnostics, Android advertising ID, app set ID and, where applicable, identifiers associated with signed-in accounts on the device. Purposes include ad delivery, measurement, analytics and fraud prevention. Provider lists in privacy forms describe potential partners, not the recipient of every request. The app does not attach your entered dates, saved names or calculation results to ad requests.

Optional one-time ad removal

Optional ad removal is a one-time purchase through Google Play, with no subscription or paid calculation features. An offer is usable only when Play supplies the current product and localized price; no fixed fallback price is used. Buying and restoring require internet. Google handles payment. The app uses the product ID, purchase state, token and Google-signed purchase data to verify, acknowledge and restore ownership on the device, without sending the token to a JN86 server. JN86 receives no card or bank account details. Google’s purchase services also process their own technical and transaction data.

A protected record on the device keeps the last verified ad-free entitlement available offline. Restore checks current ownership with Google Play. A pending purchase does not grant ad removal. If Play confirms that the purchase is no longer owned, for example after revocation, the app removes the entitlement. Temporary connection problems do not erase the last verified entitlement. The local record is excluded from Android backup. Clearing app data or uninstalling does not erase the Play transaction or request a refund.

Permissions, diagnostics and security

Calculations require no camera, microphone, contacts or GPS permission. The Google integration can use network access, the advertising ID (AD_ID) and basic phone state such as mobile network type (READ_BASIC_PHONE_STATE). App-owned diagnostics use local technical logs; there is no JN86 analytics or crash-upload service. Google SDK diagnostics are separate. Local records use Android app-private storage; the Google service connections and website links use HTTPS/TLS. This does not promise that every backup is end-to-end encrypted. Your device, keyboard, backup provider and recipient apps apply their own security practices.

Website, email and voluntary support

Privacy, website and Support links open an external browser at your request; sending email is also your choice. This website is hosted by GitHub Pages, which can process IP addresses and technical visit data. Browser storage remembers your selected language. If you email JN86VI, we and the email providers receive your address and message. We use them to answer your request on the basis of legitimate interests, then delete or anonymize them when no longer needed for follow-up, legal duties or claims.

Voluntary support through the JN86 website does not buy ad removal or any app benefit. PayPal can share transaction and contact details with the creator. Bitcoin transfers are public blockchain records that JN86 cannot erase. Any transaction information we receive is kept as necessary for accounting, tax obligations or legal claims. The selected payment or email provider applies its own policy.

Your choices and privacy contact

Use local deletion controls, Android backup and advertising-ID settings, and Google’s privacy controls for the relevant data. Buying ad removal stops banners, not necessarily consent checks, Billing or other external services. Google and other providers have their own retention and deletion rules; we cannot promise a single retention period or erase all their records. For access, correction, deletion or other applicable privacy rights concerning data held by JN86VI, email the contact below. You may object to processing based on legitimate interests and complain to your data protection authority. There is no JN86 account to delete. Please do not send passwords, payment details or purchase tokens.

Privacy contact: JN86VI

Service providers and further information

Google handles the advertising, consent and Play purchase services described above; your Android backup provider handles system backups. GitHub hosts this website, and Microsoft Outlook and other email providers deliver correspondence. Payment services handle voluntary support you initiate on the website. Their notices explain their roles, international processing, safeguards, retention and data controls.
